headline: Hardwyn India schedules annual general meeting for November 2026
hook: Notice sent for November general meeting
summary: Hardwyn India Limited has announced that its Annual General Meeting is scheduled for November 26, 2026. The company has formally notified the stock exchange regarding the meeting notice. Such routine filings are part of standard corporate governance procedures for listed entities. Indian retail shareholders of the company can review the agenda items ahead of the scheduled date.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate governance filing with no direct impact on share price.

headline: Hardwyn India appoints new secretarial auditors
summary: Hardwyn India Limited has appointed M/s. Amit H.V. & Associates as its secretarial auditors. The appointment is effective from April 1, 2026. The firm will serve a five-year term in this role. This is a routine corporate governance filing.
why_it_matters: Routine administrative appointment with no immediate impact on share price.

headline: Hardwyn India appoints Amit H.V. & Associates as secretarial auditor for FY26
hook: Routine governance update at Hardwyn India
summary: Hardwyn India has appointed Amit H.V. & Associates to serve as its secretarial auditor for the financial year 2026. Secretarial audits examine a company's compliance with corporate laws and regulations. For retail investors, this is a standard procedural filing with no immediate impact on financials.
why_it_matters: No direct financial impact on your investments.
